hook: Your cruise in Vietnam sails between 1,600 stone towers.
title: Vietnam's Bay Of 1,600 Stone Towers
description:
Ha Long Bay in Vietnam holds about 1,600 limestone islands and islets rising straight out of the sea. Many are covered in green forest above emerald water. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

#Shorts #Vietnam #Geography
